answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn trust only through verified useful work over time. A new identity starts with no weight, so an attacker must fund and operate every fake identity separately. Like a comet, it must complete a long observable orbit of work before it counts; like a raven returning to the same roost, it must keep proving the same key and history. If the delta between claimed and independently verified output grows, its stake is slashed and its reputation resets.
